name: Tengrisaurus
sum: Tengrisaurus is a titanosaur from the Valanginian Murtoi Formation of Russia, known from isolated vertebrae and among the oldest named definite titanosaurs.
wsnote: No body-size figure was read in the sources consulted.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; several isolated vertebrae.
material: Caudal vertebrae and a posterior cervical (ZIN PH 31/13) described in 2025.
